rationale: Support 0.9: The report's key conclusions are directly grounded in the two observed sources. Every earnings figure (net sales 200.6bn +20%, AWS 42.2bn +37%, AWS OI 27.5bn vs 19.2bn, net income 62.6bn, pre-tax other income 53.4bn from Anthropic, TTM FCF outflow 7.6bn) is correctly attributed to src-amzn, and every price/technical figure (271.58 close, 235.50 prior close, 265.00 open, 273.23 high, 262.01 low, 129.05M volume, 10 EMA 242.70, MACD 0.08/-0.84/+0.91, RSI 64.04, ATR 9.26, 274.99 and 278.56 window highs, 226.65/227.01 lows) matches market-amzn. Derived arithmetic (15.32%, 2.48%, 1.27x, 8.3bn, 65.2%, 13.7%, 85%, 11.9%, 19.8%, -7.43%, -1.24%, -2.51%) is correctly labeled as calculation on cited operands and checks out. The report is notably disciplined about the NO_DATA_AVAILABLE indicators (50/200 SMA) and macro/prediction-market gaps, refusing to fabricate. Minor deductions: the News Analyst's claim that no technical indicators were returned is contradicted by the observed get_indicators outputs (a cross-role inconsistency, though it does not corrupt the final decision), the 'five-session slide' framing is loose, and the sector classification is uncited. Relevance 0.95: fully on-ticker, on-date, on-task; the multi-role debate is long but each seat addresses the same decision, with only mild redundancy. Semantic validity: the report explicitly refuses to compute a trailing P/E from the single distorted quarter, correctly labels the 62.6bn as a Q2 figure containing non-operating gains, correctly labels the 7.6bn as TTM FCF, and never relabels a quarterly figure as TTM/annual. No period/unit errors and no unsupported numerical valuation assertions.
